Name: Auto Planting
Author: daitsuku
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#78B63F]Auto-Planting Mod[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#888888]Version 1.3.1 • By daitsuku • For Stardew Valley 1.6+[/color]
This mod automates the planting, fertilizing, and watering processes in Stardew Valley. Save time and effort by automating repetitive farming tasks with simple key combinations!

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Auto-Planting:[/b] Hold your modifier key (default: Left Shift) and right-click to plant seeds on tilled soil
[*][b]Auto-Clearing Obstacles:[/b] Automatically clears trees, some of debris from tillable soil (toggleable), even without proper tools!
[*][b]Auto-Fertilizing:[/b] Automatically applies your preferred fertilizer before planting (when enabled)
[*][b]Auto-Watering:[/b] Automatically waters newly planted crops (when enabled)
[*][b]Area Selection Feature:[/b] Select specific rectangular areas for planting operations
[*][b]Farm-Wide Planting:[/b] Plant the same seed type across your entire farm with one command
[*][b]Multi-Seed Planting:[/b] Plant all seed types from your inventory at once
[*][b]Water All Crops:[/b] Water every crop and tilled soil on your farm with one key press (default: F5)
[*][b]Stamina Preservation:[/b] All operations preserve your stamina/energy
[*][b]Visualization Mode:[/b] Hold the visualization key (default: Z) to see valid planting areas, tillable soil, and water sources
[*][b]Smart Fertilizer Priority:[/b] Choose your preferred type of fertilizer with automatic quality selection (Basic(3), Quality(2), Deluxe(1))
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Basic Usage:[/b] Hold Left Shift (or your configured modifier key) and right-click on tilled soil while holding seeds
[*][b]Visualization Mode:[/b] Hold Z (or your configured visualization key) to see valid planting areas
[*][b]Area Selection:[/b] Hold Z and right-click to start selection, then right-click again to complete selection
[*][b]Water All Crops:[/b] Press F5 (or your configured key) to water all crops and tilled soil on your farm
[*][b]Console Commands:[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ap_plant[/font] - Plants seeds on all tilled soil
[*][font=Courier New]ap_water[/font] - Waters all crops and tilled soil
[/list]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
All features can be configured in-game if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed:

[size=4][b]Basic Settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Enable/disable the mod[/b]
[*][b]Change modifier key[/b] (default: Left Shift)
[*][b]Change water-all-crops key[/b] (default: F5)
[*][b]Change visualization key[/b] (default: Z)
[/list]

[size=4][b]Planting Options[/b][/size][list]
[*][b]Toggle auto-clearing debris [/b](automatically clear debris, and trees from tillable soil)
[*][b]Toggle planting all seed types from inventory[/b]
[*][b]Set maximum seeds to plant[/b] (0 for unlimited)
[/list]

[size=4][b]Fertilizer & Watering[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Toggle auto-fertilizing[/b]
[*][b]Choose preferred fertilizer type[/b] (Fertilizer, Speed-Gro, or Retaining Soil)
[*][b]Toggle auto-watering[/b]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Visualization Options[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Show water tiles and tillable soil[/b] in visualization mode
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+
[/list]

[size=5][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - For easy in-game configuration
[/list]

[size=5][b]Compatible Mods[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/url] - Full compatibility with this popular expansion mod
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15383][b]Cornucopia - More Crops[/b][/url] - Compatible with additional crops (requested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120815573]Jaffe26[/url])
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15174][b]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/b][/url] - Compatible with additional flowers (requested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120815573]Jaffe26[/url])
[/list]

[size=5][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Some modded seed types may not be recognized correctly
[*]Cornucopia's planter will not work with auto-planting and must be hand placed
[*]Grasses, Wood stump, Wood log and Boulder not yet clearable (might be in the next update? idk.)
[*]Buggy auto clear debris. (to be fix later. if it is annoy you, you can toggle it off.)
[/list]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Should be compatible with most mods. If you encounter any issues, please let me know in the comments or file a proper bug report.
